student_learning_goal: I can change code and predict the new outcome.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can change code and predict the new outcome.
header.character_watermark: Coda in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Each code is altered by changing a number. Predict the new outcome.

image_placeholders.description: Six alteration rows in B&W line-art, stacked. Each ~7in × 0.7in. Format: original code on left, change instruction in middle, predicted outcome on right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_SIX_ALTERS: keywords (alter, number) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Each code is altered by changing a step. Predict the new outcome.

image_placeholders.description: Four step-alteration rows in B&W line-art, stacked. Each ~7in × 1in. Format: original code, change instruction, prediction.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_FOUR_STEPS: keywords (alter, step) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Find an alteration that DOESN'T change the outcome. Write it.

image_placeholders.description: A blank box in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2in. Top: 'Original code: ___'. Middle: 'My change: ___'. Bottom: 'Why outcome stays same: ___'. Coda thinking-bubble icon top-right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_INVARIANT: keywords (alter, invariant) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Examples: 'Swap two right steps' (commutative), 'Replace 2 ups with Repeat 2: up' (compress).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write 3 more alterations of your own.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Watch for persistence errors (predicting old outcome despite change) — flag for the change-effect reteach.
